name: Room items and acceptance: a person decides a candidate requirement, decision or question
aliases: accept reject amend a room item
room decision item to native decision
summary: Slice 2 of project rooms. Item and item-event lines in the append-only room files; states proposed, accepted, rejected, amended, superseded; accept/reject/amend/answer by a signed-in person only (R7). A requirement-editor accept creates and accepts a requirement through the B1 routes; a contributor accept submits a proposal as that person; a decision accept creates a native decision through the service-only room-decision action, which re-checks live authority and the item before a guarded write. The pointer orchestra:room/<room-id>#<seq> rides only in existing fields. An accept intent (record kind, parent, content) and the item-decision lock make one record per item: another person's retry adopts earlier attempts' records from the endpoint operation journal (unknown outcomes refused until cancelled); moderation, archive or an owner/coordinator cancel a pending intent. A derived items cache rebuilds identically from the lines; a moderated item's text is served nowhere.
